أَمْرٌ شَامِلٌ i. q. عَامٌّ [i. e. An event, or a case, that includes persons or things in common, in general, or universally, within the compass of its effect or effects, its operation or operations, its influence, or the like; or that is common, general, or universal, in its effect &c.]. (S, * O, * Msb, TA.) ―
-b2- لَوْنٌ شَامِلٌ A black colour overspread with another colour. (O, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
